name: ghest
description: Offline tracker for fixed recurring payments

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/index.js www/js/vendor/capacitor-core.js && cp node_modules/jalaali-js/dist/index.js www/js/vendor/jalaali.js && sed -i '/sourceMappingURL/d' www/js/vendor/*.js && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run vendor && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.deploy:sandbox: node scripts/build-sw.mjs --check && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy --env sandbox
